        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gw_Confirmed</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_Rejected</bpmn:flowNodeRef>

      </bpmn:lane>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gw_Merge" />
